proof:
Source: selected proof, steps 2 (admissible open sets), 3 (approximating sequences), 5–6 (definition and linearity), 7 (agreement with T) and 8 (local bound). They are carried out on ℝ^P for compactly supported continuous covector fields G; in the selected proof G = g̃. The bound (M_W(T)).toReal is abstracted to m. For (d), the selected step 8 bounds T on unit-size approximants ±ω_k by le_massOn. Here the m-hypothesis is applied to approximants of size r + 1/(k+1); in the selected node, m(W) = (M_W(T)).toReal and the m-hypothesis is supplied by eval_mass_bound (cmr_abs_apply_le_massOn), which is derived from le_massOn by rescaling. The selected node discharges the hypothesis on m; this child does not use eval_mass_bound.
Notation: Λ := Covector (Euclid P) n; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c α‖ (hypothesis). Since c is linear, |α + β| = ‖c(α) + c(β)‖ ≤ |α| + |β| and |t•α| = ‖t•c(α)‖ = |t|·|α|. 'W ⊂⊂ U' means CompactlyContained W U. Sums and real multiples of maps ℝ^P → Λ are pointwise. Elements of TestFormOn U n are identified with their underlying forms; TestFormOn U n is a real vector subspace of the n-forms, and T is linear on it.
1. (Choice of Φ.) The hypotheses on c and m are exactly those of the sibling limit_functional (dimred_mbl_fnd_tfe_exists_limit_functional) for (P, n, d, c, U, T, m). It gives Φ : (ℝ^P → Λ) → ℝ with the following property (L). Let G : ℝ^P → Λ, let W be open with W ⊂⊂ U, and let ω_k ∈ TestFormOn U n with tsupport ω_k ⊆ W. Suppose |ω_k(x) − G(x)| ≤ ε_k for all k and x, where ε_k → 0. Then T(ω_k) → Φ(G). Steps 4–7 prove (a)–(d) for this Φ.
2. (Topological facts.)
 (i) If S ⊆ U is compact, there is an open W with S ⊆ W and W ⊂⊂ U. As in the selected step 2: choose δ > 0 with cthickening(δ, S) ⊆ U (IsCompact.exists_cthickening_subset_open; U is open) and put W := thickening(δ/2, S). W is open and S ⊆ W since δ/2 > 0. Also closure W ⊆ cthickening(δ/2, S) ⊆ cthickening(δ, S) ⊆ U, and cthickening(δ/2, S) is compact because S is compact and ℝ^P is proper; so closure W, a closed subset of it, is compact. Thus W ⊂⊂ U. (Mathlib's exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure, for the locally compact regular space ℝ^P, gives the same W directly.)
 (ii) If W₁ and W₂ are open with W₁ ⊂⊂ U and W₂ ⊂⊂ U, then W₁ ∪ W₂ is open and W₁ ∪ W₂ ⊂⊂ U, since closure(W₁ ∪ W₂) = closure W₁ ∪ closure W₂ is compact and contained in U.
 (iii) If W ⊂⊂ U, then W ⊆ closure W ⊆ U.
 (iv) 1/(k+1) → 0 as k → ∞.
3. (Approximating sequences.) Let W be open with W ⊂⊂ U, and let G be continuous with compact support and tsupport G ⊆ W. For each k, the sibling uniform_approx (dimred_mbl_fnd_tfe_uniform_testForm_approx), applied with c, V := W, G and ε := 1/(k+1) > 0, gives a form ω_k with IsTestForm ω_k, tsupport ω_k ⊆ W and |ω_k(x) − G(x)| ≤ 1/(k+1) for all x. By 2(iii), tsupport ω_k ⊆ U, so ω_k ∈ TestFormOn U n. By 2(iv) and (L), T(ω_k) → Φ(G). If instead G is continuous with compact support and tsupport G ⊆ U, then tsupport G is compact. So 2(i) gives an open W ⊂⊂ U with tsupport G ⊆ W, and the above applies to this W.
4. (Additivity (a).) Let G₁ and G₂ be continuous with compact support and tsupport G_i ⊆ U. By step 3, for i = 1, 2 choose an open W_i ⊂⊂ U and ω^i_k ∈ TestFormOn U n with tsupport ω^i_k ⊆ W_i, |ω^i_k(x) − G_i(x)| ≤ 1/(k+1) and T(ω^i_k) → Φ(G_i). Put σ_k := ω¹_k + ω²_k ∈ TestFormOn U n.
 - tsupport σ_k ⊆ tsupport ω¹_k ∪ tsupport ω²_k ⊆ W₁ ∪ W₂ (tsupport_add), and W₁ ∪ W₂ is open and ⊂⊂ U by 2(ii).
 - For every x, σ_k(x) − (G₁ + G₂)(x) = (ω¹_k(x) − G₁(x)) + (ω²_k(x) − G₂(x)). Hence |σ_k(x) − (G₁ + G₂)(x)| ≤ 1/(k+1) + 1/(k+1), which tends to 0.
 By (L), T(σ_k) → Φ(G₁ + G₂). Since T is linear, T(σ_k) = T(ω¹_k) + T(ω²_k) → Φ(G₁) + Φ(G₂). Limits in ℝ are unique, so Φ(G₁ + G₂) = Φ(G₁) + Φ(G₂).
5. (Homogeneity (b).) Let G be continuous with compact support and tsupport G ⊆ U, and let t ∈ ℝ. Take W and ω_k as in step 3, so T(ω_k) → Φ(G). Then t•ω_k ∈ TestFormOn U n and tsupport(t•ω_k) ⊆ tsupport ω_k ⊆ W (tsupport_smul_subset_right). For every x, (t•ω_k)(x) − (t•G)(x) = t•(ω_k(x) − G(x)). So |(t•ω_k)(x) − (t•G)(x)| = |t|·|ω_k(x) − G(x)| ≤ |t|·(1/(k+1)), which tends to 0. By (L), T(t•ω_k) → Φ(t•G). By linearity, T(t•ω_k) = t·T(ω_k) → t·Φ(G). By uniqueness of limits, Φ(t•G) = t·Φ(G).
6. (Agreement (c).) Let ω ∈ TestFormOn U n. Then IsTestForm ω, so ω has compact support and tsupport ω is compact; also tsupport ω ⊆ U. By 2(i), choose an open W ⊂⊂ U with tsupport ω ⊆ W. For G := ω, take the constant sequence ω_k := ω with errors ε_k := 0. It satisfies the hypotheses of (L), since |ω(x) − ω(x)| = |0| = 0 ≤ 0. So the constant sequence T(ω) tends to Φ(ω). It also tends to T(ω), so Φ(ω) = T(ω) by uniqueness of limits.
7. (Bound (d).) Let W be open with W ⊂⊂ U, let G be continuous with compact support and tsupport G ⊆ W, let r ∈ ℝ, and let |G(x)| ≤ r for all x. Step 3, applied to W and G, gives ω_k ∈ TestFormOn U n with tsupport ω_k ⊆ W, |ω_k(x) − G(x)| ≤ 1/(k+1) and T(ω_k) → Φ(G). For every x, ω_k(x) = (ω_k(x) − G(x)) + G(x), so |ω_k(x)| ≤ 1/(k+1) + r. The hypothesis on m, applied to W, ω_k and r + 1/(k+1), gives |T(ω_k)| ≤ (r + 1/(k+1))·m(W) for every k. As k → ∞, |T(ω_k)| → |Φ(G)| (continuity of the absolute value) and (r + 1/(k+1))·m(W) → r·m(W). Non-strict inequalities are preserved under limits, so |Φ(G)| ≤ r·m(W).
8. Steps 4–7 prove (a)–(d) for Φ.
key_steps: Take Φ from limit_functional: T(ω_k) → Φ(G) along every sequence of test forms approximating G uniformly with supports in a fixed open W ⊂⊂ U.
Every compact S ⊆ U lies in an open W ⊂⊂ U, and unions of two such sets are open and ⊂⊂ U.
uniform_approx with errors 1/(k+1) gives an approximating sequence in TestFormOn U n for every continuous compactly supported G with tsupport G ⊆ W.
Sums and real multiples of approximating sequences approximate G₁ + G₂ (on W₁ ∪ W₂) and t•G, so (a) and (b) follow from linearity of T and uniqueness of limits.
The constant sequence ω gives Φ(ω) = T(ω).
|ω_k| ≤ r + 1/(k+1) and the m-hypothesis give |T(ω_k)| ≤ (r + 1/(k+1))·m(W), hence |Φ(G)| ≤ r·m(W) in the limit.
